“An Imperial Princess, a Duke’s heir, the next Magic Tower Master, and even a Saintess candidate?! Are you kidding me?!”
Who’s the lunatic that assigned this class roster?!
***
“If you opened your eyes and saw an unfamiliar ceiling, how would you feel?”
“I’m glad to see you again, Teacher.”
“Teacher, please live a long, long time. Promise.”
…This year’s students seem especially strange.
Is this nation’s future really going to be okay?
“It’s so quiet around you. Like another world.”
This man is just as strange.
The hero of the last war, a foretold disaster.
And the man who shares her lost memories and dark history.
“Lucien. No one will take you from me. Not this world, not even yourself.”
Just when she was trying to save a world doomed to fall,
With a calm madness, he quietly whispered,
“I won’t let that happen. Even if I have to sacrifice the entire Empire.”
…At this point, either we all live together, or we all go down together.

94501.synopsis:
Translator’s Note: The MC is found out to be dating multiple girls in the first timeline.
They got a second chance to redo their life, but become a girl during the second timeline.
The Love Interests also gets a redo and keep their memories from the first timeline.

94757.synopsis:
Choi Seonwoo, the parish priest of Shindo Cathedral and an exorcist with special powers, receives an unusual request.
The plea is to save Seo Jihan, a grandson tormented by an oppressive spirit that’s slowly killing him.
After a successful exorcism, Choi Seonwoo takes in the at-risk Seo Jihan at the rectory to care for him. But Jihan, overwhelmed by what seems like a destined connection, starts developing feelings of love for Seonwoo.
Though Seonwoo initially pushes him away, the lock on his heart gradually loosens with time. Meanwhile, Jihan goes through various trials and learns how to live like a human being.
However, just when they believe their feelings are mutual, Seonwoo makes the decision to leave Jihan behind…
Seo Jihan stopped just as the fine downy hairs on his nose barely brushed against Seonwoo’s, their breaths mingling in the narrow space.
“But why is it that I can’t seem to see you, Father?”
Choi Seonwoo suddenly noticed how long and thick Jihan’s eyelashes were, casting shadows beneath his eyes. He also realized that behind the mask of this meek lamb was the seed of a coldhearted predator.
This kid… kind of cute.
But to Seonwoo, Jihan looked no more than a caged tiger cub. Sure, if that cub grew up right, it could dominate the jungle of survival of the fittest—but for now, it was just a cub.

97061.synopsis:
Shen Meng was a corporate drone at a large factory. While on her way to deliver a contract to a business partner, she was in a car accident.
Just as she was lying paralyzed in bed, feeling miserable, she suddenly awakened a space.
Before she could even be happy for two days, the aftereffects of the space arrived. She started having strange dreams almost every night.
This quickly alerted her. Shen Meng hastily sold her house and car and began frantically hoarding supplies, to prevent herself from starving to death if she really ended up in a place with a shortage of food and clothing.
On yet another trip to hoard goods, she was in another car accident. When she opened her eyes again, she had transmigrated into a sentimental novel, becoming the vicious female supporting character who opposed the female lead and met a tragic end.
Not only was her own reputation ruined, and she died a miserable accidental death, but her four children also became extreme due to a lack of discipline. Coupled with frequent ab*se during their childhood, their psychology became increasingly twisted, leading to tragic fates.
And the man who was always serving in the military, making contributions to the country, was also ambushed, struck on the back of the head with a stick, and from then on, became foolish and idiotic. In the end, he drowned in the river during the dead of winter, clutching the clothes he wore when he married her.
To change her fate, Shen Meng could only clear her name and guide her children towards goodness, because they were all descendants of heroes. Shen Meng did not want to watch them fall into depravity.
Because she occupied the original owner’s body, Shen Meng decided to properly fulfill the original owner’s filial duties to the elders, take care of the children, and lead the whole family towards a prosperous and bright future.
It’s just that the man who had always been protecting the country and whose relationship with her was lukewarm, why were his eyes looking at her with increasing fervor?
associated_names: I Became a Vicious Supporting Role in the '70s
In the ’70s, I Became the Vicious Female Supporting Character in a Period Novel
七零，我成了年代文里的恶毒女配

97573.synopsis:
Shen Youran woke up to find herself transmigrated into a period novel as a cannon-fodder supporting female character. Her husband was about to marry his secret crush, the “Bai Yueguang” goddess, after her (the original wife’s) death. 
On top of that, the original character’s child, born from an unknown man, was set to become a mere contrast to highlight the perfect family.
When Shen Youran saw the adorable little dumpling of a child, her heart instantly melted! Now that she had transmigrated, this was her child! She became a mom without any of the pain—what a sweet deal!
Her bad husband wanted a divorce? Fine, divorce immediately! His Bai Yueguang looked down on her? Let her! The bad husband even thought she was playing hard to get, convinced she couldn’t live without him? Please!
She directly joined the military, quickly made outstanding achievements, and soon rose to the same rank as her ex-husband, standing on equal footing with him!
But then… why did her commanding officer start looking more and more like her little dumpling? What was going on here?
associated_names: 随军时不屑一顾，改嫁你首长慌啥

98597.synopsis:
Isolation fiction, analog horror, creepypasta, urban legends… Everything written in the Creepypasta Forum has become a reality.  
And I am a Veteran of that Creepypasta Forum.
associated_names: How to Survive as a Creepypasta Forum Veteran

99621.synopsis:
Lin Jing is a young artist.
Her hobby is to draw sensual pictures of KPL’s No. 1 jungler Sheng Kuang and other professional players.
Those pictures have a common feature, Sheng Kuang is always the one at the bottom.
As she continued to draw, Lin Jing became famous, and her drawings even came to be known to Sheng Kuang.
Then, in real life, Sheng Kuang dragged Lin Jing to experience the scenes in those pictures, but now Lin Jing was the one at the bottom…

99877.synopsis:
“You can never be anything to me.”
A punishment delivered by violet eyes colder than death.
Empress Elia’s chambers, which Emperor Rockfort never visited, were always quiet.
“I am… Your Majesty’s eternal second empress.”
No, in truth, she was a sinner. From the moment she became empress.
Then one day, when Elia encounters an unexpected truth,
she returns to that innocent day when she was eighteen.
Before the same life repeats itself, she had to convey the truth.
“Your Majesty. I implore you, please sentence me to death.”
No matter what words would come from the emperor’s mouth who had despised her so much,
Elia now had neither attachment nor resentment.
“What crime could you possibly have committed?”
Suddenly, the emperor began to desire her.
With passionate eyes she had never seen before.

101157.synopsis: Endy, a reincarnator, possessed cheat abilities but grew to a mediocre strength and reached his growth limit, feeling anxious about his future as an adventurer. He loved money and leisure, so he opened a classroom for his second life, thinking he could have his students pay him. Although he started the classroom on a whim, the plan was going smoothly. The students who graduated from the classroom grew into world-class strong warriors and began sending him money. Endy thought he was living a perfect second life.
associated_names: Tensei Bonjin no Eiyuu Sakusei Kyoushitsu Mihanasareta Shoujotachi

The Hero Creation Classroom of a Reincarnated Ordinary Person: After Reaching My Limit As An Adventurer, I Reluctantly Opened A Classroom In The Countryside To Earn Money For The Future, And My Student Became The Strongest
転生凡人の英雄作成教室
転生凡人の英雄作成教室～冒険者として限界を迎えた俺、仕方なく今後のための金稼ぎ目的で田舎に教室開いたら、教え子が最強になった～

101925.synopsis:
A 27-year-old South Korean office worker.
He opens his eyes in Kivotos.
However… it seems he doesn’t know this game very well!

103205.synopsis:
A few months before his twentieth birthday, Roy lost his grandmother when a robber broke into their store. Left alone, Roy was deceived by a con man named Lee Dongjae, who approached him at his grandmother’s funeral, pretending to be her acquaintance. Dongjae used Roy for his purposes and then killed him. Desiring revenge but unable to do anything, Roy closed his eyes, full of regret.
When he opened his eyes again, he returned to the day of his grandmother’s funeral.
At this funeral, Dongjae appeared again, claiming to be indebted to Roy’s grandmother. Not missing this chance for revenge, Roy gritted his teeth and beat the shameless Dongjae, sending him to prison.
Despite taking revenge, Roy’s only family, his grandmother, was gone. Recalling his former exhausting life, Roy firmly closed the door to his heart. People spoke words of comfort to Roy while he managed the Seolleongtang restaurant left by his grandmother, but everything seemed fake to him.
Before the cynical Roy, another person appears.
Like Dongjae, this person also claimed to have a connection with Roy’s grandmother – Han Seongwoo.
Despite his bright appearance, the man is polite and obedient, with a strange obsession contrasting with his submissive attitude. He often visited the restaurant like a stalker, waiting for Roy all day, like a tamed dog-.
Sa Gongwoo
He has regenerative abilities with high physical recovery. Raised in a state orphanage, he continued to work as a hunter associated with the government after awakening his powers. His warmest memory is of Roy’s grandmother feeding him in his youth. Hearing the news of the grandmother’s death, he sets out to find Roy, but Roy didn’t believe him.
Despite Roy becoming prickly and sharp, unlike before, Seongwoo finds this simply charming and touching. He volunteers to be a devoted supporter, generously giving gifts, as he finds Roy adorably cute to death.
Cho Roy
Originally kind-hearted and cheerful, he became cynical after being deceived, killed, and then returned to the past. Falling into distrust of humanity, he decided never to allow himself to be used as a fool again. However, Han Seongwoo, who appeared after Roy’s grandmother’s death, consistently approaches Roy with kindness, even when Roy coldly pushed him away. Insisting that he would never trust people again, Roy can’t help but worry about Seongwoo, who continued to get injured.
One day, he suddenly gained the ability to open doors that could transport to certain spaces.

103973.synopsis:
Just because a guy fits your type doesn’t mean he’s a good person.
But a man who’s only kind? Only smart? He’s nothing more than a nice guy—forgettable, unimpressive, incapable of igniting real desire. Women don’t dream about men like that. They settle for them. And no one wants to be a consolation prize.
The world is unfair like that.
High school, college, even the so-called real world—women hold the power to choose. They dictate the game, decide who wins, who gets left behind. So if you’re miserable, if you keep ending up with bastards and cheaters, whose fault is it, really? You made the choice. You picked wrong. And if you want to be happy? You better learn how to judge men properly.
And so, we arrive at the story of Nakanishi Yuuya—a man on the losing side of the equation.
Too nice to be wanted.
Too smart to be fun.
Too self-aware to be happy.
Will his voice—his quiet, desperate pleas—ever be heard?
Come, let’s watch and find out.
This is that kind of story.
associated_names: それ、男運が悪いわけじゃない。おまえの男を見る目が壊滅的なだけだ

107813.synopsis:
I stole the Holy Sword, Holy Book, Magic Tome and Spirit Pearl after being kicked out of the hero’s party.
But why did it make me into a woman?

109605.synopsis:
After nearly four months of brutal war, the mighty empire of Cheongwolmok, led by Grand King Yoongeon, succeeds in conquering the Western Kingdom of Seoro. 
Though the nation now lies at his feet, Yoon Geon, instead of executing its foreign king, Seo Hwi, locks him away in the royal harem — solely for the fact that Seo Hwi dared to hold out against him for so long.
A year passes.
The Grand King, who had all but forgotten Seo Hwi’s existence, suddenly remembers — and decides to humiliate him.
“You’ve been living here for quite some time now, and yet, as your ‘husband,’ I haven’t even properly consummated our union.”
Seo Hwi only laughed — openly, mockingly.
“You want me to spread my legs? Go on, then. Try it—if you can.”

110629.synopsis:
Lin Huanyu traveled through time and space to become a disabled male insect cub Sera, and was required by the system to torture the female military “mother” who was taking care of him.
The system said that his “mother” Edwin was awakened by the torture of the male insect and turned to the rebel army, which was the key to reversing the destruction of civilization.

114725.synopsis:
What to do when she’s favoring handsome men and suddenly learns of national ruin and family destruction, becoming a Fallen Princess?
Xiang Ying stated that, of course, she would immediately utilize her Space to empty out the Imperial Palace, leaving not a single thing for the enemy army!
As the captain of an apocalypse infrastructure team, she transmigrated into a book due to an explosion.
The enemy army invaded the Imperial Palace, a famine year was approaching, and she was surrounded and became a prisoner, also with three children.
Facing such a catastrophic start, Xiang Ying exclaimed, “Good days are coming!”
Compared to the apocalypse, what is this?
On the road to exile, while others suffered hardships, she enjoyed herself; everyone else gnawed on steamed bread when hungry, but Xiang Ying and her children ate well and drank well.
Everyone else grew thinner and thinner, only her three children remained chubby and fair-skinned, holding their bellies and frantically waving their hands: “Mother, we can’t eat anymore, we really can’t!”
Xiang Ying held hot pot, milk tea, and large plate chicken, enjoying the scenery on the road to exile, fleeing and hoarding supplies all the way, her life becoming more and more flavorful.
The villainess supporting character laughed at her: “What’s the use of just having grain? You’re still a s*ave of a fallen nation!”
Xiang Ying immediately pulled out the Imperial Seal: “You’re right. From today onwards, I want to be Empress.”
The enemy army was dumbfounded; she hadn’t said that the 300,000 vagrants she brought were elite soldiers!
*
On the day Xiang Ying restored the kingdom, the man who had accompanied her through all her hardships took her hand.
Xie Chen: “For the sake of the three children, can you give me a proper status now?”
Xiang Ying: “Men should be dutiful, don’t ask for a title.”
Xie Chen: “…The kingdom as a betrothal gift, my Imperial Seal, my country, all for you.”
Xiang Ying: “Deal! Wedding night tonight!”
associated_names: 流放？灭国？她搬空国库带崽造反

115749.synopsis:
Jiang Chen transmigrated into a domineering CEO novel, becoming a cannon-fodder lackey by the side of the second male lead, and was bound to a gossip system.
The lackey had looks and money but wasn’t the sharpest tool in the shed. He was a stumbling block on the path of the main couple’s romance—stubborn and troublesome—so his ending was predictably tragic.
His family went bankrupt, his parents died, he ended up in prison, and was “specially taken care of” on the male lead’s orders, ultimately taking his own life in despair.
Jiang Chen decided to cling to the second male lead’s coattails, play the role of a gossip-enjoying bystander, and steer clear of the chaotic main couple.
The female lead skipped school, refusing to take the college entrance exam. The second male lead tried to persuade her, even locking her up and hiring tutors to catch her up.
[It’s useless. This lovesick fool only has eyes for her little delinquent boyfriend, Yellow Hair. She’s not just skipping school—she got caught bringing Yellow Hair into the girls’ dorm to sleep and was sent home by the school to reflect.] 
[As expected of the female lead, absolutely wild.] 
[Yellow Hair’s no saint either. He planned to trick her into being sold off. Though our boy stopped him in the end, and she got into her dream university, she still holds a grudge against him for breaking up her romance.] 
[Our boy’s got it rough!] 
[Wait, hold on—our boy actually let her go?] 
[She got sold.] 
[And bought by the male lead… uh…] 
Following the second male lead with his system, Jiang Chen indulged in gossip, only to find the plot veering further off course. The second male lead’s gaze toward him grew increasingly strange.
On the surface, Jiang Chen played innocent, but inside, he was thrilled. [My boy, Daddy loves you! Daddy’s gossip will lead you to the peak of life!] 
Lu Chiyuan had long felt something was wrong with his world. He had a privileged background, a sharp mind, and a strong physique—his life should have been bright and dazzling, yet he was inexplicably trapped in a strange cycle.
That cycle revolved around his parents’ adopted daughter, Shen Zhiyi. His excellence seemed to exist solely to clean up her messes.
It wasn’t normal.
Lu Chiyuan wanted to break free, but whenever the thought crossed his mind, he’d suffer splitting headaches and absurdly bad luck—choking on water, crashing his car, roads closed by fog. He was stuck, only able to move forward by catering to Shen Zhiyi.
Fed up with this life, Lu Chiyuan was once again forced to ditch a business partner to return and deal with Shen Zhiyi’s chaos when he suddenly gained the ability to hear someone’s thoughts.
It was his subordinate, a lackey who appeared soft and obedient but had a vivid, audacious inner world, eagerly playing the role of his “dad.”
[My boy’s so handsome. I love you, my boy.] 
Lu Chiyuan kept him close, and from then on, the gossip never stopped.
Shen Zhiyi refused to take the college entrance exam. The lackey: [She’s doing it on purpose to sabotage your business and make you lose money.] 
Lu Chiyuan decisively let go, choosing to respect her fate.
The male lead tried to steal Lu Chiyuan’s business. The lackey: [No worries, the female lead will mess things up for him, and he won’t sign the contract. We can swoop in.] 
Lu Chiyuan called a meeting with the relevant departments, prepared thoroughly, and secured the deal.
He discovered that as long as the lackey was near, the world’s rules couldn’t control him—the closer, the better the effect.
Later, when Lu Chiyuan was ambushed and the world’s consciousness urged him to seek out Shen Zhiyi, he defied the rules, stumbling to the lackey’s doorstep and knocking.
The moment the door opened, his sunlight broke through the world’s heavy shackles, shining on him.
After a chaotic night, the lackey played ostrich.
Lackey: [This wasn’t in the book! Holy crap, the plot’s completely derailed.] 
Lu Chiyuan held the lackey tightly in his arms. This wasn’t derailment—this was everything falling back into place.
associated_names: 总裁偷听我心声，在线改剧本

117029.synopsis:
“I want the female masters of the Jianghu.”
With that one line from the emperor, my life as an imperial guard started to go off the rails.
Well, an imperial command was an imperial command, so I somehow managed to kidnap a few female martial artists from the Jianghu…
“This maiden wishes to stay by your side, my lord.”
For some reason, they keep clinging to me.

118309.synopsis:
“Here are the divorce papers. Please divorce me, Your Majesty.”
One day, Clementina, infamous as the wicked queen, handed her husband divorce papers. With a bright smile, she spoke.
“Just the other day, I had the pleasure of witnessing your true love… Thankfully, it opened my eyes. Therefore, I’ve decided to step down as queen.”
After all, they had flaunted it so blatantly. The shock even caused her to regain the memories of her previous life, and a love that had lasted a thousand years was instantly frozen solid.
Today marks her graduation from being the convenient woman.
From now on, she will simply enjoy her leisure.
Having made peace with everything, the wicked queen wrapped up her affairs and promptly left the castle.
associated_names: The Evil Queen Enjoys Her Leisure Time

119077.synopsis:
After transmigrating into a post-apocalyptic novel, the System informs Sang Luo that her fiancé, the male protagonist, has abandoned her to run off with his one true love, the female protagonist. Her mission, should she choose to accept it, is to get revenge.
Sang Luo: “?”
“I’d rather just die, thanks.”
So she cuts her finger and smears it with zombie blood.
System: “???”
It awakens a water-elemental ability for her in a panic-induced scream.
When the food at home runs out, Sang Luo lies on the floor like a salted fish. “Starving to death is also an option.”
System, weeping: “If you go find food, I’ll awaken a space-elemental ability for you!”
Sang Luo reluctantly agrees.
Later, she stumbles upon a heavily injured person.
System: “AHHH! That’s the final villain! Save him! You can team up with him later to kill the main characters!”
Sang Luo decisively abandons him.
System, having a complete meltdown: “If you save him, I’ll awaken a fire-elemental ability for you!”
Sang Luo thinks for a moment. “In that case, I want lightning.”
After all, the power is out at home, and a lightning ability would be perfect for watching TV.
System: “…”
…
Before she knows it, Sang Luo has collected every single elemental ability.
Her: “Huh?”
Later, at a survivor base, the power-level testing machine explodes when she touches it.
She yawns: “Did you guys find this thing in a dumpster?”
Out on a mission, Sang Luo does nothing but sleep or doze off. The team decides to teach her a lesson by deliberately leaving her behind in a zombie horde.
A while later, she catches up to them without a single scratch on her. “Hey, why didn’t you tell me you were leaving?”
Everyone: [stunned_dog_face.jpg] 
How did she get back?!?
The great villain’s heart was once a barren wasteland.
At first, he: “Only idiots believe in disgusting things like feelings.”
Later—
He holds up a bowl of porridge he cooked himself, coaxing the person sleeping lazily in bed: “My sweet treasure, just have a few bites before you go back to sleep.”
Tsk, everyone has their moments of eating their own words.
associated_names: 这条咸鱼她是满级大佬
這條鹹魚她是滿級大佬

119589.synopsis:
When I woke up…
My consciousness had transferred into Camille Romanov, the villainess from the otome game “Personal Lovers.”
This is… a reincarnation as a villainess!?
—But right now, that doesn’t matter. It’s not important.
In this world… in “Personal Lovers,” there exist humanoid mobile weapons.
So, as a robot-loving otaku, there is only one thing I must do!
I don’t care about avoiding ruin or anything else.
In this world, I aim to become the strongest ace pilot!
associated_names: 悪役令嬢に転生しましたが、人型機動兵器の存在する世界だったので、破滅回避も何もかもぶん投げて最強エースパイロットを目指します。

123941.synopsis:
In the third year after returning to the Jiang Family with Jiang Huaixu, he got engaged.
The bride was not me.
I quietly shed the last tear, and as I packed my luggage, he leaned against the door.
Dressed in a suit, his tone was like discussing a business deal:
“An Qin, you who have nothing, and my fiancée who can offer me a commercial empire.”
“Choosing the latter, you understand, right?”
Yes, I understand.
He was no longer the boy from the slums who clutched my clothes and said, “Don’t leave me.”
So when Jiang’s Mother threw a check at me-
Ten million or him.
I didn’t choose him either.

124453.synopsis:
Despite being given multiple chances to be reborn, the female lead’s endings always turned tragic. The collapse of these small worlds left the Heavenly Dao overwhelmed and exasperated.
Eventually, the Heavenly Dao’s favoritism toward the original female lead faded with each collapse and instead shifted toward the male leads—men who seemingly had everything except the ability to love or be loved.
【Since she doesn’t want it, then so be it.】
And so, Zixi entered the small worlds, giving these obsessive male leads a unique, exclusive kind of love that belonged only to them.
But just as these male leads started to fall for Zixi and the feelings became mutual, the original female leads began to regret their choices.
Too bad—there’s no such thing as a regret pill in this world. People have to take responsibility for the choices they make.
associated_names: 快穿：他们只是缺爱小可爱

132133.synopsis:
I was reincarnated as the villainess noble daughter…’s little sidekick.
Just a disposable background character, really. Surely I wouldn’t get much screen time in the story, and after quietly exiting, I could live a safe and peaceful life, right?
Bad Ending: killed by the protagonist’s party.
Normal Ending: life imprisonment.
True Ending: revealed as the hidden Boss and new Demon King, killed by the protagonist’s party, with my soul sealed away for eternity.
‘When you play a game, you’re supposed to—’
associated_names: 恶役千金小跟班也要避免死亡结局

132901.synopsis:
In the third year of Hanyu, during the Emperor’s selection of palace beauties, Gu Han, the legitimate daughter of the Marquis of Rongyang’s manor, entered the palace by imperial decree.
Within three years, she climbed from the rank of Cairen to Noble Consort, receiving the Emperor Lu Yu’s unfading favor. Gu Han knew well what she sought: wealth, glory, and the flourishing of her clan.
When a new concubine entered the palace, the place Lu Yu most loved to visit was always Cairen Gu’s quarters. Beautiful and delicate, she played coy and temperamental, yet never competed for favor.
Later generations would say that ever since Gu Han entered the palace, she was always the most favored among the imperial consorts. But only Gu Han herself knew that her path was like treading on thin ice. If she had shown the slightest mercy or softness, the one left standing in the end would never have been her.
If one has already enjoyed a lifetime of family love in the first half, then surely it is time for someone else to enjoy the glory and wealth in the second half.
associated_names: The Noble Consort’s Rise to Power

144421.synopsis:
In his previous life, Jiang Luo— the real young master who had been switched at birth—spent his entire life clashing with Zhao Mingshi, the fake young master who grew up in wealth and privilege under Jiang Luo’s rightful identity. Jiang Luo dreamed of everything that Zhao Mingshi obtained so effortlessly: parental love and attention, resources handed to him on a silver platter, and a high-class social circle he had access to since childhood.
Jiang Luo fought with everything he had, yet in the end, his biological parents still didn’t love him. No one sincerely helped him. Even the business he took pride in barely stayed afloat, and his own brother stabbed him in the back.
Given a second chance, Jiang Luo finally figured it out.
 He had the looks, he had the brains—why should he waste another life competing with Zhao Mingshi?
Parental affection?
 Who cared?
The Zhao family’s connections and resources?
 Not worth a damn.
Jiang Luo realized that once he kicked all of that aside, his life would open up infinitely.
So when Zhao Mingshi came crying in front of both families, begging Jiang Luo not to kick him out of the Zhao household, Jiang Luo slapped him across the face and sent him flying with a kick:
“Get the hell out! Take both your birth parents and adoptive parents with you! Don’t stand in my way!”
After that, Jiang Luo relied on his sharp mind, guts ordinary people didn’t have, and talent one in a million to start carving his own path through H City’s business world.
People used to know him only as that pitiful kid who got switched at birth and look at him with sympathy or judgment. But soon enough, “President Jiang” became a name that swept across the entire commercial circle. Everyone respectfully called him: Young Master Jiang.
—
With a new life ahead, Jiang Luo’s goals were simple: money, power, and living freely.
Later, he added one more thing—Huo Zongzhuo.

151333.synopsis:
“You are Villadriel Hinaris?”
“I am,” Luo Wei nodded.
“You’re saying… the Witch of Forbidden Curses, exiled from eternity by the gods; the Usurper of Fire, who turned her back on the flame of civilization; the Wicked Sorceress who commands both madness and reason; the Master of the High Tower, who walks alongside the profound and unfathomable abyss… is you?”
Luo Wei thought for a moment, then nodded again. “That’s right.”
“Then who am I?”
“?”
——————————
Black powder, difference engines, flintlocks, steam machinery, magical potions, rituals, arts, and curses…
When these things, some familiar and some strange, appeared in the same era, Luo Wei realized she had arrived in a world utterly different from her own.
However, before the magnificent, perilous, and treacherous adventure could begin, Luo Wei had to consider one problem first.
“What do I do if I’m mistaken for a world-ending witch? Waiting online, urgent!”

153381.synopsis:
After the life winner Shao Chenyen died, he was unexpectedly bound to a mission system. 
From that point on, in every world he entered, his children were villains. One after another, they were all turned into cannon fodder. 
Left with no other choice, he could only personally step in and teach the children how to be proper people.
From then on, Shao Chenyen embarked on the road of raising and educating his little brats.
associated_names: I'm the Villain’s Good Father [Quick Transmigration]
我是反派的好爸爸[快穿]

164389.synopsis:
Seo Haena had been reborn into a dark, confinement-themed novel.
To prevent her beloved sister’s death, she had to change the story.
